name: GEOMELIX
summary:
Game Modes

Survival Mode: Test your speed and accuracy by eliminating as many numbers as possible within a time limit. Clearing one polyhedron seamlessly transitions you to the next, keeping the action continuous. Quick successive taps grant bonus time, adding a strategic layer to the gameplay.​
Normal Mode: Choose your preferred polyhedron and aim for the fastest completion time. Each shape tracks your best records, encouraging replayability and mastery.​
Features

Diverse Stages: From regular to semi-reg
